scope_rule: One central scientific question per task. Every required cohort, control, ablation, condition and robustness analysis belongs to that task. Cases, folds, source versions, models and access arms never add task counts. Endpoint reproduction is not whole-paper reproduction.
evidence_date: Retained reviewed metadata as of 2026-11-14; no new live network verification in this phase.

paper_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paper_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paper_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paper_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

neural_conditions.direct: No-tools inference on the complete canonical signal packet and target-free permitted context.
neural_conditions.numerical: Numerical tools on the identical packet. Frozen-program versus per-case adaptive tool use is separately logged within this task.
neural_conditions.specialist: Audited fixed feature extractor or train-only physiological model on identical information; trained model access is an assistance condition, not evidence of unaided understanding.
neural_conditions.parity: Same case IDs, inputs, units, masks, training/calibration exposure, protected answers, and transform support. Raw versus lossy derived signals are separately labelled input substrates; no equivalence assumed. Richer-input specialists are auxiliary.
neural_conditions.interpretation: Association, tool use, public exposure and physiological understanding remain separate. No model campaign is selected.

required_machine_submission.common: Versioned manifest of every expected case/biological group/condition, input profile, split, training identities, seeds and inference recipe; predictions keyed by exact private roster case IDs; finite outputs on fixed grids, masks and units; all failures/statuses retained; runnable analysis and complete comparator/uncertainty tables.
required_machine_submission.validation: Reject duplicate/unknown IDs, target-bearing inputs, missing expected cases, wrong grids/units/shapes, nonfinite values or outputs outside declared probability/event support. Undefined metrics and source-ineligible cases remain typed coverage outcomes; no success-only aggregate.
required_machine_submission.probabilities: Vectors in frozen class order, finite and nonnegative and summing to one; serialization tolerance and any log-loss floor must be frozen in executable scorer before running, applied equally to all arms, never fitted to outcomes.
required_machine_submission.paper_score: Recompute published estimands and uncertainty from full declared scope; retain discrepancies, not agreement with a preferred conclusion. Published-method equivalence and scientific tolerance remain implementation gates.
required_machine_submission.heldout: Role-specific physical TRAIN, DEV and HELD exports. TRAIN fits transformations/normalization; DEV selects methods/hyperparameters; frozen inference on HELD. Evaluator alone reads held targets. Overlapping contexts and repeated biological units cannot cross boundaries.
required_machine_submission.uncertainty: Use authentic biological grouping. Cells/trials/session repeats are not independent animals or people. Report every group; few-animal studies disclose population-inference limitations. Across-task aggregation accounts for shared sources.
required_machine_submission.failure_accounting: Expected census fixed before outcomes. All exclusions retain source eligibility reasons, missing/invalid predictions fail completeness, and null-support failures remain visible. No convenience cohort replaces full scope.

global_implementation_holds: Authenticate rights, complete immutable file inventories, biological identities, units, eligibility and source-field joins.
Build target extraction, protected role exports, exact parsers/scorers, meaningful invented controls, competent full-scope references, grouped uncertainty and contamination records.
Freeze method grids, compute budgets, numeric policy, scientific tolerances and null support before authentic execution.
Complete independent source and actual review precedes later claims; current proposal executes nothing.

count_policy.older_unregistered_six_dossiers: Dedup context only; no registration proposed.

publication_context.historical_administrative_text: Proposal-era counts, recommendations and source-phase observations in inherited fields are historical. The package registry records the applied 233-draft programme state; no authentic readiness is inferred.
publication_context.private_locator_policy: Null path fields identify private construction evidence that is not shipped or dereferenced. Original byte/hash pins are provenance references, not public validation certificates or dependency availability.
